melbheat: Explore Hot Days and Hot Nights at Melbourne Airport

Source: R/melbheat-package.R
melbheat-package.Rd

The package bundles daily temperature observations from the Melbourne Airport weather station, two helpers for counting and comparing hot days and hot nights, and a Shiny app that puts them in front of a user.

Details

  • melb_temp is the data set.

  • annual_exceedances() counts days per year above a threshold and flags years with too many missing observations.

  • summarise_periods() and describe_periods() compare the average annual count before and after a chosen year and say how sure we can be.

  • threshold_sensitivity() checks whether that conclusion depends on the threshold.

  • plot_exceedances() and plot_sensitivity() draw the results.

  • run_app() launches the Shiny app.
